The Legal Department handles all of KBRA’s legal matters, with the exception of ratings analysis and determinations. The Legal Department works with analysts, compliance, finance, technology and senior management across the company.

As an Assistant General Counsel, your responsibilities may span a broad range of in-house legal matters and may include the review, negotiation and drafting of client engagement letters; subscription agreements with clients across various product offerings; vendor agreements for various types of services and products; all other types of contracts to which KBRA may be a party; and management of KBRA’s contracts. - Intellectual Property: You will assist with protecting KBRA’s intellectual property, including filing and managing trademark and copyright registrations, and negotiating license agreements.

hip – including direct engagement with Xantium Co-Founders – Fellows will make immediate contributions through real-world projects.

The overall experience shall enable Fellows to discover their natural niche, hone in on an ideal role and team, and transition into their permanent professional home at the end of the program.

Program Structure

- Six-Month Timeline: The program begins with an “Initial Immersion” rotation featuring 10-12 weeks of immediate, hands-on deployment into real work alongside seasoned professionals. Fellows then transition into a 3-week cohort-wide classroom training led by experienced speakers and Xantium leadership hosted at one of Xantium’s main offices. The experience concludes with a 10-12 week “Capstone” rotation of more advanced deployment, allowing Fellows to build off their learnings to tackle another set of projects.

- Dedicated Mentorship: Fellows are matched with a long-term career "Advisor" for the full six months, alongside rotation-specific business unit "Facilitators" who provide immediate team onboarding and daily project direction.

- Fluid Learning Tracks: Rather than rigid silos, the structure allows Fellows to tailor their journey, absorbing both Trading and Analysis content to find the unique intersection that best suits one’s talents.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform fundamental and quantitative research, analyzing market dynamics, industry trends, and company-specific data to support actionable investment decisions.

- Build and maintain financial models, monitor portfolio risks, and assist in evaluating complex company valuations.

- Fuel trading desks by analyzing pricing, simulating market dynamics, and assisting with trade execution and lifecycle management.

- Drive key business initiatives alongside Portfolio Managers, Analysts, and Traders, collaborating with colleagues globally across London, New York, Abu Dhabi, Singapore, and Hong Kong.

- High adaptability and self-direction, capable of seamlessly transitioning between rigorous academic theory and hands-on execution.
